hold_text: Deploy-script change (scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh, run by ict-git-sync every ~5 min on the live VM). Tier 2 by the lane brief: landed as a HELD PR; the manager has it reviewed and merges. Deliberately not armed for auto-merge.
